name: Image to 3D (Pixal3D)
description: Pixal3D. Upload a picture of one object and get a textured 3D model (.glb). The background is removed first.
promptGuide: This preset has no prompt. It only needs a start image. Use a picture of one single object, whole and in the middle of the frame, on a plain background, with even light and no other objects in front of it. A product shot or a 3/4 view works best. Text, people in groups and full scenes (rooms, landscapes) do not work well.
licenceNote: Pixal3D and TRELLIS.2 are MIT. The DINOv3 image encoder it uses has its own licence (Meta). Check that licence before client work.
